+title: 'Bind the composer to the SessionModel prompt helper: pending user message, cancel, both echo orders'
+---
+## What
+Source: update.md §4.2 ("Prompt helper"), §4.7 ("Composer"), §5 (`PromptResponse.messageId`).
+
+- [ ] `PromptInputView` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Input/PromptInputView.swift`) and `ThreadActionTasks.swift` send with `SessionModel.prompt(_:meta:)`. The model adds a local pending user message at once (`SendState.pending`), so the composer adds no row of its own.
+- [ ] The stop button calls `SessionModel.cancel(meta:)`.
+- [ ] `UserMessageView` shows the send state: pending, sent, failed.
+- [ ] `PromptQueue` sends the next queued prompt only after the current prompt returns.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] After send, the user message shows at once as pending, and becomes sent when the agent links its `messageId`.
+- [ ] The result is the same when the echo comes before the response and when it comes after the response.
+- [ ] A failed prompt marks the message as failed and adds an error row.
+- [ ] Stop sends `session/cancel`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Input/ComposerSessionModelHostedTests.swift`: the two echo orders (use the echo-after option of `ScriptedWireAgent`); a failed prompt; stop sends `session/cancel` (assert on the frames of the scripted agent).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+    - `PromptResponse` in alpha.7 has only `messageId`. The turn continues after the response. `cancel(meta:)` takes `SessionModel.promptTraceMeta` so that the cancel joins the trace of the turn.
+    - `UserMessageView` shows no send state now.
+    - Plan: the composer uses the session model when the environment has one, and the old thread path stays until ^h1116ab. The prompt block build moves from `ACPThreadActions` into a `SessionModel` extension in `ThreadActionTasks.swift`, and `ACPThreadActions.send` calls it. `PromptQueue` gets `dequeueNext(after: StateUpdate?)`. The composer keeps a flag while a prompt has not returned, and sends the next queued item only when the prompt returned and the agent does not run.
+    - To see the pending state in a hosted test, `ScriptedWireAgent` gets an option that holds each prompt answer until the test releases it.

--- original
+++ modified
@@ -13,6 +13,19 @@
     - Plan: the composer uses the session model when the environment has one, and the old thread path stays until ^h1116ab. The prompt block build moves from `ACPThreadActions` into a `SessionModel` extension in `ThreadActionTasks.swift`, and `ACPThreadActions.send` calls it. `PromptQueue` gets `dequeueNext(after: StateUpdate?)`. The composer keeps a flag while a prompt has not returned, and sends the next queued item only when the prompt returned and the agent does not run.
     - To see the pending state in a hosted test, `ScriptedWireAgent` gets an option that holds each prompt answer until the test releases it.
   timestamp: 2026-10-05T23:05:44.605906+00:00
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m47605sphwjdafxp971rkp8t
+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed (TDD: each new test failed first, then passed).
+    - `ThreadActionTasks.swift`: `SessionModel.sendPrompt(with:)` sends with `prompt(_:meta:)`, and `SessionModel.startCancel()` sends `cancel(meta: promptTraceMeta)`; a failed cancel adds an error entry. The prompt block build moved here from `ACPThreadActions`, and `ACPThreadActions.send` now calls `sendPrompt(with:)`. New internal `ComposerTurn` picks the session model when the environment has one, else the thread and its actions. It is shared by `PromptInputView`, `DefaultPromptAccessory` and `PromptQueueView`.
+    - `PromptInputView`: reads `\.sessionModel`. It counts the prompts that did not return. A submit goes to the queue while the agent runs or while a prompt did not return. The next queued item goes out only after the prompt returns, through the new `PromptQueue.dequeueNext(afterAgentState:)` (nil or idle that is not cancelled lets the queue go on; running, requiresAction, unknown and cancelled hold it). The old thread path did not change.
+    - `UserMessageView`: shows the send state ("Sending", "Sent", "Not sent") with the identifier `UserMessageView.sendStateIdentifier(for:)`, colored by the new `AgentTheme.StatusColors.color(for: SendState)`.
+    - `SessionModel.isRunning` added in `SessionTranscriptEnvironment.swift`; `isLastWhileRunning` uses it.
+    - `ScriptedWireAgent.holdsPromptAnswers` and `releasePromptAnswer()` hold each prompt answer, so a hosted test can see the pending state. `stop()` releases a held answer.
+    - Discovery: a negative wait with `waitUntil` (2 s) in the hold test went past the 5 s bound in the full run, and the bound then stopped the agent. A short fixed pause (50 ms) fixed it. Do not raise the bound.
+    - Known limit: in ACP v2 the prompt response can come before the `running` state update. Then the queue can send the next item after the response and before `running` arrives. The card asks only for "after the current prompt returns", and that holds.
+    - Not in this card: the composer still reads slash commands and config options from the thread (^szmaef8).
+  timestamp: 2026-10-05T23:22:20.854704+00:00

 - 01M443NN55C6HTFT2F2REPFZA1
